verdict.rationale: Asaas documents a public REST API with API-key authentication, a full payment API reference (create, list, update, remove, capture), and a sandbox for testing flows. An llms.txt index and a docs MCP server make the documentation consumable by AI assistants. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: With the Asaas API, you can automate charges, receipts, and payments via Pix, bank slip (boleto), credit card, debit card, and TED.
The Asaas API uses an API key to identify the account responsible for the request. Send the key in the access_token header.
create payments, process card payments at creation time or later, and capture payments with pre-authorization.
You can test flows such as creating customers, charges, payments, transfers, and Webhooks before using Production credentials.
Through the API, you can create subaccounts so that each customer has an individual account, carries out financial operations, and manages their own payments.
